# Codes

This area groups the standardized clinical and administrative identifiers used within the Danish Inflammatory Bowel Disease Database (DANIBD) to track patient care. It covers procedure codes for surgeries, endoscopies, and patient education that form the basis of national quality indicators, alongside treatment codes that register the administration of biologic and targeted synthetic drugs. Together, these classifications provide the quantitative foundation for benchmarking clinical interventions, monitoring medication usage, and evaluating equitable IBD care across Danish regions.

## Pages

- [[topics/codes/procedure-codes/index|Procedure Codes]] — Catalogs SKS and NPU identifiers for surgical interventions, endoscopies, and patient education used to calculate national IBD quality indicators.
- [[topics/codes/treatment-codes/index|Treatment Codes]] — Registers specific biologic and targeted synthetic drug administrations to track medication usage and treatment equity across pediatric and adult cohorts.
